title: Stocks Slide as Hot Inflation & AI Credit Fears Hit Markets
text: The Close brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Vanguard President & CIO Greg Davis, UBS Equity Research Analyst, Large-Cap Banks & Consumer Finance Erika Najarian, Janus Henderson CEO Ali Dibadj, CreditSights Global Head of Strategy Winnie Cisar, DoubleLine Global Sovereign & Emerging Markets Head Bill Campbell, Cisco Chair & CEO Chuck Robbins, Blackstone Global Head of Digital Infrastructure Mike Forman, Nuveen Global Head of Infrastructure Jessica Bailey, KKR Head of North American Infrastructure Brandon Freiman, Loop Capital Founder, Chairman & CEO Jim Reynolds, & Huel CEO James McMaster. (Source: Bloomberg)
